scope: Reviewed current main index.html, simulation-validator.js, race-gradeability-evidence.js, pre-race-provider-freeze.js and associated tests; not a proof that every historical file or every repository module was enumerated.

findings.evidence: PR #169 merged; both gradeRace and gradeDataset reject missing or failing assessRaceGradeability before metrics.
Legacy export uses browser-device-unverified clock and warns explicitly; no official chart, certified performance, or ROI calculation in inspected handler.
Structured freeze uses provider isolation and pre-post safeguards but local-only timestamps; UI explicitly says NOT independently timestamped.
Read-only model input recomputation, not a historical freeze or performance report; warning explicitly notes current edits/scratches may differ.
Sample horse/trainer angle prose includes source trainer ROI figures; these are not generated model-performance ROI.

Boolean evidence flags are accepted without independent source identifiers or cryptographic provenance. Callers can set all three to true; test fixtures deliberately do so. Gate is a fail-closed policy check, not itself proof of authenticity.

gradeabilityEvidence.field.entries and rankedPrograms are caller-provided and are not independently cross-checked against r.runners, race identity, or freeze artifact. A valid-looking but mismatched evidence object could pass.

remaining_actions: Bind evidence manifest to graded race ID, runner identities and prediction artifact ID; reject mismatch.
Require independently verifiable provenance records for PDF replay, official chart, and external timestamp rather than trusting booleans.
Inspect any additional or external performance report generators before declaring systemwide protection.
Execute production original-PDF replay and obtain official chart plus independent freeze evidence.
